needs_attention: Deposit pending: Moenad Nadeem re-booked for Oct 7 install and was asked for a deposit to hold the slot — unpaid as of this run.
Won customer Munsif flagged a removed shoe moulding on Sept 22; 4 days later only automated nurture has touched him, no resolution.

Meeting-scheduled opportunity for Maria Wildfang ($41,150) has had zero follow-up in 98 days since her visit — the single largest gap in the account; there is still no follow-up sequence for this stage.

24 of 25 open Meeting-scheduled opportunities have had no real follow-up since their appointment (median effective window used: only ~26 of the 30 days before stale_lead would apply) — this is the account's biggest structural gap, not a one-off.

3 stale_lead-tagged 0a. New Lead contacts (Henry Martinez, Roni Benjamin, Mohammad Zubair Sadiq) were abandoned only 7-9 days after creation — much faster than the documented 14-day stale / 28-day abandon config. Worth checking whether the live GHL automation changed without platform-settings/ghl-workflow.json being updated.

5 ASAP (Hot) leads (Ulupi Babu, Simon Liu, Julie Ohlman, Mala Lutchman, Nishtha Garg) are already past 100% of the 7-day stale threshold with no stale_lead tag ever applied — the automation does not appear to be firing reliably on this stage either.
Moenad Nadeem is actively booking and paying for a new job but carries no lead:* tag and has no open opportunity tracking the deal.
Horshay Horhayba gave detailed material specs (Calcata gold marble, exact unit) before the Meeting-scheduled opportunity lapsed to abandoned — worth one more manual look before writing it off.

reporting.store_pipeline_note: STORE: Material Pipeline has 49 open records running its own +3d/+8d auto follow-up cadence (13 already sitting in Closed-Won stage without status flipped to 'won', 28 in the +8d final follow-up stage). No stale thresholds are defined for this pipeline — volume only, no staleness prediction.
